Commentary.Commentary: Gabriel started well and Nurse too was decent but the others couldn't pick wickets consistently. As the innings progressed, West Indies' accuracy started waning and allowed the visitors to dominate the proceedings. The last five overs produced 56 runs as England finished well. The track isn't easy to play shots on and West Indies have their task cut out. Join us in a while for the chase.

Fine batting performance from England after put into bat. They lost early wickets but skipper Eoin Morgan's fluent ton resurrected the innings. He started slowly and then expanded into his trademark clean hits to put the tourists on top. Billings and Stokes partnered their skipper for vital stands on a dicey surface. Ali played a handy cameo as well to push the total closer to the 300-run mark.
Another full ball outside off, Ali lifts it just over the covers and picks up another couple. ENGLAND FINISH ON 296/6.
Full and outside off, miscues the lofted drive over extra cover. Falls safe in the deep as long off goes to his right to stop it. Brace taken.
Full and outside off, Ali goes for the booming drive but misses.
Chris Woakes is the new man in.

OUT! Bizarre way to end a great knock! Back of a length outside off, Ali makes room and pulls it back down the track to the bowler. Brathwaite leaps to make a good stop and finds Morgan backing away well down the track. The big bowler fires a direct hit at the bowler's end to remvoe the England skipper but the latter has more than done his job. Well played, son!
Slower bouncer outside off, Ali steps out and tries to pull but misses.
50-run stand between Morgan and Ali!
FOUR! Handy runs! Very full and wide outside off, Ali tries to dig it out but gets a thick edge that flies just past the keeper to the third man fence.
Full and outside off, Ali mistimes the heave towards long on. One bounce to the fielder as the batsmen get a single.
Fuller outside off, driven down to long on for a single.
Full and on off, gets across and clips it down to fine leg for a single.
In the air but safe! Full and outside off, makes room and lofts it inside out over the covers. Doesn't time it well but it falls safe as the batsmen get a brace.
Shortish on middle, goes for the pull but misses. Delayed call for a wide for height, harsh one to be fair.
Fuller outside off, drilled down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Slammed! Length ball on off, Morgan makes room and pummels the drive through the covers to find the fence. He continues to middle them.
Jason Holder is back.
Outside off, pushed gently towards cover for a single.
10th ODI hundred for Eoin Morgan!

SIX! Take a bow skipper Morgan! There are always questions regarding his place in the side and he continues to prove them wrong. A responsible knock on a two-paced surface. Brings up the three-figure mark with a top shot. Back of a length ball outside off, he just mauls the pull cleanly over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. Cracking stroke!
Full and angling across the left-hander, steps out to play the big shot but cannot reach it. Wide called.
Good length outside off, Ali flashes at it but gets an under edge past the keeper to third man for a single.
Slower ball on back of a length outside off, makes room and slices it past cover for a run.
Fuller and outside off, gets across and heaves it away to long on for a run.
Length ball outside off, swung away down to long on for a single.
Carlos Brathwaite is back on.
Another mishit lands safe! Floated outside off, uses his feet and slogs but miscues it towards deep mid-wicket. Doesn't carry to the fielder and they get another brace.
Fuller on off, leans forward and drills it down to long on for a single.
Full and on off, swept away to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Good placement! Fuller on middle, Ali makes room and slams it straight down the ground this time as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Drifting in on middle and leg, Ali mistimes the lofted stroke but luckily for him, the ball doesn't carry to long on. A brace taken.
Speared down the leg side, Morgan flicks and Hope fumbles as they get an extra run as well.
FOUR! Not an ideal start! Floated around off, Morgan goes for the reverse sweep and makes good connection. Clean strike and it races away to the third man fence.
Bishoo to bowl another over. Can he pick up a wicket or two here and keep the runs in check?
Full toss on middle and leg, worked past square leg as they go for the second run. A better throw at the keeper's end could have made things interesting.
Full and sliding down the leg side, Ali misses the whip stroke. Wide called.
Very full and on middle, squeezed towards the mid off region.
Full toss outside off, pushed gently to mid off for a single.
Good length on middle, worked towards wide long on for a brace.
Full and outside off, crisply driven through the covers for a brace.
Floated around off, leans across and pats it to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, reaches out and drives it to long off for a single.
Floated around off, leans across and pats it to mid-wicket.
Moeen Ali is the new man in.

OUT! Stokes holes out! Full and outside off, he goes for the big hit down the ground to long on. Doesn't get the desired distance on the stroke and Holder takes a comfortable catch. Just when he was threatening to run amok, West Indies have removed him. Fine knock from him nevertheless.
Full and outside off, makes room and lobs it over the covers for a brace.
Floated outside leg, reverse sweep and gets it through point for a single.
Full toss on middle and leg, steps out and whips it to long on for a single.
Devendra Bishoo is back.
SIX! Makes full use of the Free Hit! Full and in the slot, Morgan picks it up and deposits it just over the leaping long on fielder for a maximum. Runs coming freely now for England.
100-run stand between Morgan and Stokes!
Full toss but Stokes mistimes the heave down the ground to long on for a single. Late call for a no ball. Free Hit coming up now...
Fullish around off, Morgan squirts it down to long off for a run.
Another full toss, Stokes slashes at it but gets it off the outer half towards third man for a single.
9th ODI fifty for Ben Stokes!
Full toss but Stokes doesn't make full use of it. Mistimes the heave to long on for a brace. Nicely paced knock from the all-rounder, has set himself for the grand final flourish.

SIX! Smashed! Stokes is turning it on now. Length ball and he is staying deep in the crease. Stands tall and belts it with the wind way over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. If he bats through, England could finish with a total well past 300.
Full toss and on the pads, whipped away to deep mid-wicket for a brace where Kraigg Brathwaite makes a neat stop.
Shortish on middle, swivels and pulls it down to fine leg for a single. Back to back tidy overs for the Windies.
Shortish outside off, Morgan opens the bat face late to glide it to towards short third man who anticipates well to stop it to his right. Single taken.
Length ball outside off, Morgan mistimes the drive towards extra cover.
Shortish outside off, slashed away to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller outside off, pushed firmly towards the mid off region.
Stokes was backing away a lot and Holder cleverly fires it wide outside off. No shot offered expecting a wide but a good call by the umpire.
Jason Holder is back on for another spell.
Outside off, it's pushed to the covers for a single.
Short and wide outside off, with room on offer Stokes looks to cut it away but misses.

SIX! Didn't exactly middle it but it's enough to go all the way. Stokes pulls this back of a length delivery on middle and off but to his advantage, he hits it with the wind. It's flying towards the rope where Kraigg Brathwaite is positioned. He runs back and tries to take it, but has already crossed the line in this attempt. So as the ball hits him, it's already a biggie.
Wide! Sprays it way down the leg side, wide called.
Slants across a length delivery around off, Eoin is a bit cramped for room as he gets a bottom edge on his cut shot. It falls just beside him and the batsmen take a quick run.
Hit and miss! Short and wide outside off, Eoin Morgan stands firm and looks to slash it over the point region. It's too far out for him to make any connection though.

FOUR! Full and on the pads, easy as they come as Morgan just tickles it fine down the leg side. Gets it past a diving Shai Hope and picks up a boundary as it races away to the fine leg boundary. Leg byes signalled by the umpire actually so it must have gone off the pads.
Shannon Gabriel to bowl now.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full around off, driven through to long off for a run.
Nicely tossed up on the stumps, Stokes has a go at it but gets it off the inside half on the on side for a single.
Eoin Morgan brings out the reverse sweep once more and places it through backward point. Jogs to the other end to complete the run.
Tossed up on off, worked straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Darted full and flat on the stumps, Morgan goes for the reverse sweep but cannot connect. Gets it off the pads behind to the keeper.
Devendra Bishoo is back on to bowl.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Five fielders are now allowed outside the ring.

SIX! THAT'S OUTTA HERE! What a shot from Ben Stokes. Tossed up and right in the slot, Stokes clears his front leg and smokes it back down the ground. Clears the long on boundary with ease and ends the over with a maximum.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Short one again, a pull down to long on enables the batsmen to take a run.
Flat and short around off, Eoin quickly goes back and pulls it through towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy on a length outside off, Morgan goes back and cuts it towards point.
Tossed up outside off, it's pushed to the cover.
Fullish outside off, it's pushed down to long on for a single.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Angling into the body, no trouble for Eoin Morgan to pull it along the ground to fine leg. One run taken.
On the shorter side, it's hit through the covers for a single.
Seeing Stokes back away, Carlos follows him. Bowls it on a length and it's defends it to extra cover.
Back of a length angling in on the hips, it's pulled away on the leg side for a single.
Stays right behind the line and keeps it out. End of the over.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full outside off, driven to mid off.

Dropped! A chance Shai Hope should have taken. Floats it just back of a driving length outside off, Morgan charges out to whack it away but gets a faint nick on it. Hope drops it and even misses a stumping chance. Big chance has been missed.
Some drift and dip for Nurse, Morgan plays it off the inside half on the on side.
Slower short ball angling in, Stokes pulls it wide of mid on but won't get any run for it.
Good length delivery around off, a solid front foot defense presented by Ben Stokes.
50-run stand between Morgan and Stokes.
On a good length, outside off, Morgan with an open face steers it down to third man for a run.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Seeing Stokes give the charge Carlos bangs it in short, Ben who initially wanted to pull had to sway away from it.
Back of a length outside off, Eoin waits for it and plays it very late. Cuts it down to third man for a run.
On a flatter trajectory, outside off on a shorter length, it's punched away off the back foot on the off side.
Short and wide outside off, easily done by Morgan as he cuts it through towards sweeper cover for a single.
Flighted ball on middle and off, Stokes milks it down to long on for a run.
Looped up just around off, driven through the covers for a run.

FOUR! Great placement and excellent execution. Dropped short, Morgan picks up the length early and goes back. Muscles the pull over mid-wicket and bisects the gap between the two fielders out in the deep to perfection. Beautifully hit.
Loopy and pitched on a length outside off, Morgan goes back and slaps it to the cover fielder.
Coming back in on a fuller length around off, Morgan pushes it to covers for a run.
Shortish in length outside off, Ben taps it away on the off side and takes a brisk single.
Full and just around off, Eoin Morgan leans across and forward to drive it to long on for one run.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, Stokes turns it behind square on the leg side. The fielder from fine leg runs to his right and cuts it off, a single is taken.
Fuller in length, on the stumps, it's driven to long on for an easy single.
From around the wicket, it's on a back of a length angling in from around off, Morgan stays deep inside his crease and keeps it out.
Carlos Brathwaite returns to the attack.
Floated outside off, reaches out to that one and blocks it well.
Floated outside off, Stokes whips it away to wide long on for a brace.
Drifting in from outside off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Floated outside off, leans into it and blocks well.
Flatter outside off, stays back and drills it to long on for a single.
Flatter outside off, Morgan sits back and pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Drinks break....
Low full toss and Morgan bunts it straight down the ground towards long off. Carlos from long on races to his right and puts in a tumbling dive to prevent the boundary. Brace taken.
Full and outside off, leans across and pushes it past mid on for a single.
Dug in short around off, too high and wide called as it sails over Stokes.
Good length around off, Stokes gets back to block but gets an inside edge on to the pad.
Another short ball around off, Stokes pulls but straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Shortish on middle, pulled through backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! Nice shot! Back of a length outside off, Morgan flat bats it straight back down the track. Stokes times his leap in time as it goes past him down the ground to the long off fence.
Drifting in from outside off, gets on the front foot and blocks well.
Nicely looped off break on a length, spins away as Stokes plays inside the line.
Tossed up gently outside off, presses forward and smothers it to the ground.
Drifting in on a length from outside off, Stokes pushes it towards point.
Floated outside off, sits back and powers it down to long on for a single.
On a length outside off, stays back and slaps it down the ground to long on for a single.
Jason Mohammed comes on to bowl.
Shortish and outside off, tapped to cover for a single.
Fuller on middle, wristed powerfully to the mid-wicket region but cannot find the gap.
Shortish around off, steps out but gets into an awful tangle. Lobs it towards short fine leg as they steal a brace. Fine running.
Back of a length outside off, Morgan pushes at it but is beaten.
32nd ODI fifty for Morgan.
Short on off, pulled away through mid-wicket for a single. Responsible knock from the skipper, he needs to carry on.
Good length around off, Morgan steps out to play the big shot but gets an inside edge towards the short fine leg region.
Jason Holder is back on.
Floated outside off, gets back and blocks solidly.
Fuller on middle and leg, gets across and works it towards mid-wicket.
Drifting in from outside off, stays back to cut but is beaten by the extra bounce.
Floated outside off, stays back and blocks it well.
On a length outside off, sits back and pushes it to cover where Holder stops it but overbalances to concede a brace.
Floated outside off, reaches out and drives it back to the bowler.
Shortish outside off, hangs back and blocks it well.
On the pads, worked through square leg for a single.
Shortish outside off, tapped towards cover-point for a brisk single.
Good length on middle and leg, defends it solidly from the crease towards the bowler.
Back of a length outside off, strange-looking shot from Morgan as he looks to waft at it but is beaten due to the extra bounce.
There are checking the flap of the helmet and it is being reworked. After a brief delay, he is ready to resume.

Crash! Dug in short around middle, Morgan swivels to pull but misses to be struck on the back of the helmet. He takes off the helmet immediately and takes some time off to cool off. Seems fine which is good news.
Quicker ball around off, sits back to pull but mistimes the stroke. Just short of the man at long on. Single taken.
On a length around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
FOUR! Up and over! Floated around off, makes room and chips it high over mid off. Clears the infield comfortably to find another boundary. He is batting beautifully.
FOUR! Smashed! Flatter outside off, keeps a touch low but Morgan adjusts well to pull it cleanly over mid-wicket. Long on goes to his left but cannot stop the boundary.
Flatter on off, gets back and punches it to short mid-wicket.
Flighted around off, gets across and pushes it to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, gets across the stumps and works it past mid-wicket for a single.
Short of a length outside off, stays back and taps it towards point.
Fuller outside off, driven firmly towards mid off.
Back of a length around off, gets back and blocks it well.
Short of a length outside off, stays back and blocks it towards cover.
Back of a length outside off, stabbed towards cover for a single.
Shannon Gabriel is back into the attack.
Ben Stokes is the next batsman in for England.

OUT! BLINDER FROM CARTER! Massive wicket for West Indies as Buttler can be a deadly customer once he gets set. It's Nurse with his second scalp although Carter should get the credit for this. Loopy ball around off, Buttler looks to flick but gets a thick leading edge that flies quickly to first slip where Carter plucks it one-handed leaping to his right.
Flatter outside off, stays back and slaps it down to long off for a single.
Flighted around off, nudged to short mid-wicket for a brisk single.
Drifting in on middle and leg, worked past square leg as the batsmen go for the second run. Could have been trouble but the throw is absurd and wayward.
Fired outside off, Morgan goes back and punches it to deep point for a single.
Fuller outside off, reaches out and drives it down the ground to long off for a single.

FOUR! Just over the fielder! Floated outside off, Morgan goes for the sweep but gets a top edge that just clears short fine leg to race away to the fence. Bishoo is easing the pressure on England with his spell.

FOUR! Good placement! Half-tracker from Bishoo and Morgan pounces on the offering in a flash. Pulls it cleanly over the infield on the leg side. Bisects deep mid-wicket and long on perfectly to find the fence.
Flatter outside off, stays back and blocks solidly.
Another wide as Bishoo loses his radar and sends it down the leg side.
Bishoo spears another one down the leg side, Morgan misses the flick and it is a wide.
On a length outside off, sits back and slaps it towards sweeper cover for a run.
Flighted outside off, Buttler eases it through the covers for a brace.
Floated outside off, stays back and defends it towards short cover.
Floated on middle and off, worked past mid-wicket for a single.
Floated around off, Buttler plays the reverse sweep but straight to point.
Floated outside off, once again Buttler is beaten as he was playing for the spin.
Slider outside off, Buttler pushes at it but is beaten as the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
On a length outside off, stays back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Flighted around off, employs the reverse sweep and it beats short third man for a couple.
Flatter and short outside off, Buttler goes back and slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Quicker ball on middle and leg, Morgan stays back and works it past square leg for a single.
Flighted wider outside off, reaches out and slams it down to long off for a single.
Lovely leg break and it spins past the outside edge as Buttler pushes at it.
Fuller outside off, pushed through mid on for a single.
Drifting down the leg side, Morgan misses the flick. Wide called.
FOUR! Smashed! Bishoo drops it short and Morgan cashes in with a mighty pull over mid-wicket to find the fence. Rubbish ball and it got the treatment.
Drifting in from around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Full and outside off, Buttler pushes it through cover for a brace to get off the mark.
Flatter and around off, stays back and blocks it well.
Jos Buttler is the next man in to bat. He has a slip in place for him.

OUT! GOT HIM! Timely strike for the Windies and Billings' fine effort is nipped in the bud. He would have liked to carry on and score a big one as this is a slightly dicey surface. Coming to the ball, flighted outside off and Billings used his feet to flick but couldn't keep the stroke down. Brathwaite at short mid-wicket took the sharp catch. A promising partnership is broken.
Darted on off, rocks back and flat bats it towards long off for a single.
Flatter on middle and leg, sits back and pulls it through square leg for a single.

Almost carried! Probing over from Bishoo. Looped up outside off, Billings goes for the big drive but gets a thick edge. The fielder from backward point goes to his left and puts in a dive but it doesn't carry. Single taken.
Floated around off, Morgan steps out to whip it away but the ball goes off the pads to the off side. A leg bye taken. Lot of events in this over.

Morgan makes room to go inside out but misses the leg break. Hope whips off the bails but Eoin's foot was in the crease. He is lucky that the ball spun a bit as otherwise it would have crashed into the stumps.
Slips this down the leg side, that shall be a wide.
Floated outside off, Morgan goes for the reverse sweep but is struck on the pads.
2nd ODI fifty for Sam Billings!
Drifting in from outside off, steps out and clips it towards mid on for a single. Smart knock from the young man, it's not been an easy surface to blast away.
Floated wider outside off, uses his feet and pushes it towards the point region.
Devendra Bishoo is brought into the bowling attack for the first time today.
Very full on off, Morgan squeezes it out back to the bowler.
Floated outside off, stays back and taps it to the off side.
Fired down the leg side, Morgan misses the sweep stroke. Wide called.

FOUR! HAMMERED! On the shorter side outside off, Morgan hangs back and effortlessly clobbers it well over the mid off fielder as the ball races to the fence for a boundary. Easily cleared the infield.
Drifting in around off, steps out and clips it towards deep square leg for a single.
Looped up on a length outside off, sits back to push at it but gets it off the bottom half of the blade.
Flatter on the stumps, Morgan sits back and powers it down the ground to long on. Single taken.
Dug in short around off, Morgan pulls it through backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length around off, gets back and works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
50-run stand between Billings and Morgan!
Shortish around off, stays back and mistimes the pull through mid-wicket to the deep. The batsmen get three. Good partnership this after the early loss of wickets.
Full and outside off, reaches out and guides it to short third man for a sharp single.

FOUR! Nicely done, lad! Length ball outside off, reaches out and flat bats it powerfully straight back past the bowler. Good strike and easily wide of the mid off fielder as the ball races to the fence.
Length ball angled in from around off, gets back and jabs it towards mid-wicket.
Quicker ball outside off, reaches out and pats it to the off side for a quick single.
Floated outside off, uses his feet and defends solidly.

JUST SHORT! Morgan tries to unsettle the spinner by using his feet. Doesn't get to the pitch but goes through with the lofted stroke. Mistimes it and luckily for him, it doesn't carry to the long on fielder. Single taken.
Quicker ball from around the wicket, Morgan gets the stride in and blocks.
Flighted outside off, slight shuffle by Billings and he powers it down the ground to long on for a run.
FOUR! Poor ball and bashed! Full toss and Billings sweeps it powerfully through backward square leg to find the fence. He won't miss out on such freebies.
Short of a length outside off, Morgan sits back and defends well.
Shortish outside off, Morgan gets back and slaps it to the left of the deep cover fielder for a couple.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and jams it towards gully.
Length ball around off, Morgan uses his feet to play a hoick across the line but misses. Would be better off to play straighter on this surface.
Good length outside off, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length outside off, gets across the stumps and tucks it towards square leg.
Drinks break!
Quicker ball around off, Morgan makes room and pats it towards cover.
Loopy around off, leans across and clips it towards short fine leg.
Flatter on off, stays back and works it past mid-wicket for a single.
Floated outside off, Billings misses the reverse sweep and the ball goes off the pads past the keeper. Unwanted appeal for lbw and it's turned down.

Drifting in from around off, turning in, Billings gets back to whip it away but gets it off the inner half towards short fine leg. Single taken as Brathwaite fumbles a bit in mopping up. The batsmen get the second run as well. Sloppy from the big man.
Loopy and around leg stump, pushed gently towards mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Billings shuffles across the stumps and tucks it towards square leg.
Back of a length around off, Morgan uses his feet and smacks it through the covers for a run.
Shortish outside off, Morgan cuts it but cannot beat point.
That's cut him into half nearly. Back of a length around off, nips in a touch as Morgan chops it towards the off side.
Shortish outside off, Morgan hangs back and taps it towards the gully region.
Back of a length outside off, reaches out and dabs it towards short third man. The ball hit the splice of the bat. Wants the single but is rightfully sent back.
Flatter on the stumps, stays back and whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slip comes out and goes to short third man.
FOUR! Does it again! Another reverse sweep, this time in front of point. Beats the diving fielder and it speeds away to the fence for another boundary. Nice smart batting from the young man.
FOUR! CHEEKY FROM BILLINGS! Brings out the reverse sweep and makes fine contact to get it past backward point to the third man fence. The 50 comes up for WI with the boundary.
Flatter and outside off, Morgan makes room and bunts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Loopy and well outside off, Billings steps out and mistimes the drive down to long on. Single taken.
Flatter on middle, stays back and pushes it firmly towards short mid-wicket.
Decides to make a leave to a harmless length ball outside off stump.
Back of a length around off, Morgan hangs back and blocks it firmly to the bowler.
Length ball angled across the left-hander, Morgan steps out and makes room for the drive but finds the extra cover fielder.
Nicely judged single. Billings tapped it towards the cover-point region with soft hands and Morgan was quick to respond to the call.
FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Full and outside off, Billings shuffles across the sticks and whips it away wide of the mid on fielder. Nicely struck and it races away to the fence for a boundary.
Good length angled in from around off, pushed gently back to the bowler.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and pushes it towards short extra cover.
Flighted on the stumps, another premeditated paddle by Morgan and this time he makes contact. Gets a brace down to fine leg.
Drifting in on off, Morgan gets across for the premeditated paddle and is struck on the pads. Stifled appeal for lbw but turned down. Probably impact was outside the line.
On a length around off, stays in the crease and blocks solidly with the full face of the bat.
Drifting in from outside off, steps out and whips it away down to long on for a single.
Floated around off, Billings looks to work across the line but gets a soft leading edge to short cover.
Ashley Nurse comes into the attack now.
Keeps it outside off, stays back and blocks it solidly. Maiden from Brathwaite to start, should have had a wicket too.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length closer to off, blocked well from the crease.

Poor shot! Length ball outside off, Morgan charges down the track to play an ugly slog but misses it totally. Not sure if this is the right approach so early in the innings with the side two down. Yes, aggression is good but you have to be selective.
Full and outside off, pushed gently towards cover.

DROPPED! How West Indies would have loved another wicket at this stage? Full and outside off, Morgan drives loosely away from his body and gets a thick edge on it. It was Powell's catch at first slip but he is blinded by Hope going across him and eventually, the chance is shelled. Reprieve for the England captain.
Carlos Brathwaite comes on to bowl.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. Which means that a maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Fuller length delivery on middle and leg, worked away straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Tad fullish in length, around off, driven to the left of Holder at mid off. He moves to his left a bit and gets low to stop it.
Quite full and outside off once more, the away movement on offer yet again as Sam drives it to mid off. Another dot ball.
Good length delivery moving away a shade around off, Billings pushes it to the mid off fielder for nothing.

FOUR! That's put away! Quick use of the hands from Sam Billings. Gets it on a shorter length, on middle and off, he short-arm jabs this over mid-wicket for a boundary. Cleared the infield with ease and since there was no protection out in the deep, sent it across the rope.
Back of a length on off, Billings hangs back and with an open face, dabs it behind square on the off side.
Length ball, on middle and off, Morgan stands his ground and works it away down on the leg side.
Shoots off the surface a touch, on a back of a length, Morgan defends it off the splice.
FOUR! Shot. Full and outside off, a lot of room on offer which the England skipper will not miss. Leans into the shot and crisply drives it through the covers for a boundary.
Skids across the left-hander on a back of a length, Morgan with a solid back foot defense as he walks across to block.
On a nice length, moving away from outside off, Eoin Morgan has nothing to do with that one.

Nicely played and that's equally well fielder. Back of a length around off, Billings walks across and wrists it to the right of mid on. Carlos Brathwaite however is up for it and he stops it with a good dive to his right. Stops a certain boundary. Keeps the batsmen down to just the one.
Full outside off, Morgan drives this to the extra cover fielder to end the over.

That's kept slightly low once again, very uneven wicket, this. Length ball just outside off, Morgan misses as he tries to get it away on the off side. He'll feel lucky that didn't crash into the off pole.
On a good length, just around off, Morgan comes ahead and blocks it away on the off side.
Slants across a back of a length delivery, around off, Morgan looks to play it tamely from inside the line but misses.
Eoin Morgan is next in at No.4.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! It's kept low once again and this time Joe Root is gone. Caught on the back foot and the extra pace has done him in. Good length ball on middle and leg, keeps very, very low as Root looks to put bat on ball. It skids right through and knocks the stumps over. That's a big, big wicket for the West Indies, the English run-machine is gone.
Back of a length outside off, Billings dabs it to third man for one.

Good running between the wickets. Sam drops this just behind on the off side and quickly responds to Root's call. Joe slides his bat in as the fielder from backward point comes running in and underarms it at the stumps. Misses however so no problem for Joe either way. But, if he had hit, he would have been gone. His bat got stuck in just before the crease.
Similar delivery, outside off, Billings once again plays this with an open bat. Dabs it in front of backward point but won't get any run for it.
Back of a length in the channel outside off, Billings stays put and taps it down on the off side.

Beautiful timing. Fuller length ball on the stumps, Root with excellent balance leans across and flicks it through the mid-wicket region. It won't go all the way but it's enough to fetch him three good runs.
Swinging back in from around off, Root covers the line well and shoulders his arms to it.
Jason Holder, who had left the field after that dropped chance, is back on.
On a back of a length, outside off, Root pushes it off the back foot on the off side.
Coming in on the stumps, Sam walks a step across and blocks.
The groundstaff are getting together as it has gone a bit murky out there. Probably they are anticipating the rain. As I type, TINY DROPS OF RAIN CAN BE SEEN on the camera lens.
Back of a length, on off, Billings gets big and defends it down.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Root leans ahead a touch and gets it off the inside edge as connects. It thuds off the pads and goes on the leg side as a single is taken.
Joe Root is in at No.3.

OUT! ROY IS GONE! A little unfortunate, though, to be honest. Gabriel bowls it on a length around off, it keeps quite low though and comes in to catch Roy by surprise. He is unable to bring his bat down in time and rapped low on the pads. Shouts for a leg before to which the umpire responds to immediately. The dangerous Roy departs and West Indies are off to a good start.
Back of a length outside off, Billings stands tall and crunches it through cover-point. Gets it in the gap and picks up three runs for doing so.

FOUR! Lovely, lovely shot. Billings with beautiful timing. Full ball on the stumps, Sam leans into it and drives it straight back down the ground. Carter chases it down and tries to parry it back in but cannot to do. Boundary!

Dropped! Technically obviously, but a difficult chance nonetheless for Jason Holder. Fuller length ball around off, Roy is early into the shot and drives it on the up straight back. Holder sticks his hands out to catch it but cannot hold on to it. Chance goes begging.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Good length delivery on off, once again Jason Roy keeps it out solidly.
Bowls this just back of a length, shaping back in from around off, Roy meets it with a straight blade and keeps it down on the track on the off side.
This time he connects and middles the pull. However, much to his misfortune, he finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Shortish well outside off, Roy looks to ride the bounce and pulls it away on the leg side but cannot make any kind of connection on it.

Beautiful stuff from Shannon Gabriel, but this is streaky stuff from Sam Billings. Length ball coming back in from around off, Billings throws his bat at this to hammer it through the covers. Misses and is lucky the ball didn't take the inside edge. Testing over from Gabriel comes to an end.
Curling back in on middle and leg, Sam with a straight blade plays it back down the track. Dot ball.
Jason Roy plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run is taken.

Oooooof!! What a ball. Almost got Roy there. Jason almost pays the price for poor foot movement on that occasion. It's full and swinging away at the last second, just around off, Roy looks to drive it away but is beaten past the outside edge.

Big swing and a miss! Fullish length delivery outside off, Roy plants his front foot forward seeing the width and has a real go at it. Misses it completely as Shai Hope behind the stumps collects it in his gloves.

Movement once again for Shannon Gabriel. Bowls it at a good pace and pitches it outside off, on a good length it's shaping away and Billings is beaten as he looks to steer it behind square on the off side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length ball outside off, it's run down to third man for a single.

FOUR! Lovely timing. It's a bit fuller and Roy has latched on to it in a flash. He makes great use of his wrists, flicks it past the mid-wicket fielder for back-to-back boundaries. Roy has gotten a move on here.
Fine leg comes up inside the circle. Mid-wicket drops back to the fence.
FOUR! Nicely done by Roy. He waits for it, gets behind the line of this short of a length delivery and wrists it ever so well through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Short of a length, just outside off, Billings drops it with soft hands on the off side and scurries across to complete the run.
Banged in short and going down leg, Billings leans across and looks to go after it, doesn't connect and looks to the umpire for a wide. Doesn't get any response from him, much to his surprise.
Too full and too straight, Roy takes advantage of this and walks across a step, flicks it past the mid-wicket fielder and gets two runs to his name.
Bit fuller in length, moving away from around off, good swing for Shannon Gabriel as Jason Roy has a go at it. Misses as it goes behind to the keeper.
Fires it right up there, just outside off, Roy gets it off the bottom part as he attempts to drive it away. Plays it back down the track and gets no run for it.

Another shout for a leg before. But this one is a little clearer as it was clearly going down leg. Billings looked to flick it away but was caught low on the pads. A leg bye is taken as the batsmen run through for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Billings goes after it but is beaten by the away movement.

Loud shout for an lbw! And that didn't look too far away as well. Gabriel wastes no time and immediately gets it to angle in on middle and leg, Roy looks to play it across the line but ends up getting hit on the pads. There's a loud shout for a leg before but height seems to be an issue, maybe going down leg as well. A leg bye is taken.
Shannon Gabriel will bowl from the other end with the second new ball. He also has two slips in place...
Fuller length delivery in the off stump channel, Billings takes a big stride forward and keeps it out with a straight blade.
Good length delivery well outside off, some movement in the air as Sam Billings leans forward, covers the line and shoulders his arms.
And we're away! Full and angling in on the pads, Roy picks it off his pads and flicks it down to fine leg for an easy single.
Keeps it on the shorter side, outside off, another watchful leave from Roy.
Great carry on that occasion. Banged in on a shorter length once more, outside off, this time Jason Roy has nothing to do with it.
Holder starts off with a back of a length delivery just around off, there's some good bounce on that occasion as Jason Roy gets behind the line to keep it down on the ground.

The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. It's bright and sunny out there, just what we like to see. Jason Roy and Sam Billings to open the innings for England as Jason Holder takes the new ball first up for the hosts. He has two slips in place. Here we go...
The weather has cleared and the conditions have improved well enough for play to commence. A 30-minute delayed start but what is important is that we are finally starting.

PITCH REPORT - Jeff Dujon reckons that there is a covering of grass coupled with the moisture which should mean that there could be help for the West Indian pacers early on. The surface is a bit tacky and overall it should get better as the game progresses. Feels that the team winning the toss must opt to bowl, especially as nine out of the last ten matches were won by the chasing side.
Update 0930 local - It has started to rain again and it is quite steady as well. Covers are back on.
England (Playing XI): Jason Roy, Sam Billings, Joe Root, Eoin Morgan(c), Ben Stokes, Jos Buttler(w), Moeen Ali, Chris Woakes, Adil Rashid, Liam Plunkett, Steven Finn

West Indies (Playing XI): Evin Lewis, Kraigg Brathwaite, Kieran Powell, Shai Hope(w), Jason Mohammed, Jonathan Carter, Jason Holder(c), Carlos Brathwaite, Ashley Nurse, Devendra Bishoo, Shannon Gabriel.

TOSS - WEST INDIES WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO FIELD. Clearly a decision made due to the showers and there is a possibility that rain could return at some point later on and so Holder wants to play it safe. The early moisture should aid the pacers probably with the new ball.

Hello and welcome to England's brief ODI tour of West Indies that features three matches. It will be another opportunity for the visitors to finetune their preparations for the Champions Trophy. The hosts haven't qualified for that mega tournament but will hope to use this series as a platform to improve their form in this format. Won't be easy though as England look formidable, at least on paper and they will be keen to bounce back after the disaster in India recently. It was raining in the morning but thankfully it's passed. Toss is coming up.
